channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Bruce Brown | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Bruce Brown from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Mike Brown on Bruce Brown
item.description:
Mike Brown on what he's liked from Bruce Brown so far in camp:

“It's great that you're able to get vets like him into camp because you get to know them, just as much as their game. He's been doing a nice job. He was with the group a few nights ago ... those guys made a couple of mistakes but they played hard -- not just defensively, moving the ball quickly, etc...”

Mike Brown on Bruce Brown, Oct 12, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Darko Rajakovic on Bruce Brown
item.description:
Darko Rajakovic on Bruce Brown's nice (and expensive) gesture:

“He's a big cowboy and he loves his boots, and that style of life and the music. So it's pretty cool what he did for the team.”

Darko Rajakovic on Bruce Brown, Oct 10, 2024. Source: x.com.

item.title: Masai Ujiri on Bruce Brown
item.description:
Ujiri on Bruce Brown:

“Bruce was cleared in the summer. As he began to ramp up his knee flared up ... all summer Bruce was good, he participated with the team [in off-season workouts]. But when it flared up we made the decision collectively ...”

Masai Ujiri on Bruce Brown, Sep 30, 2024. Source: Twitter @michaelgrange.

item.title: Nikola Jokic on Bruce Brown
item.description:
Harrison Wind:Nikola Jokic on losing Bruce Brown:

“Of course we're mad at him. Maybe we don't give him a ring.”

Nikola Jokic on Bruce Brown, Oct 2, 2023. Source: Twitter @HarrisonWind.

item.title: Nikola Jokic on Bruce Brown
item.description:
Harrison Wind:Nikola Jokic on Bruce Brown:

“When he took a step-back 3 I wanted to punch him, but when he made it I was so happy.”

Nikola Jokic on Bruce Brown, Jun 10, 2023. Source: Twitter @HarrisonWind.

item.title: Michael Malone on Bruce Brown
item.description:
Harrison Wind:Michael Malone:

“I don't think people understand the importance that Bruce Brown is going to bring to this team.”

Michael Malone on Bruce Brown, Sep 26, 2022. Source: Twitter @HarrisonWind.

item.title: Kevin Durant on Bruce Brown
item.description:
Gary Washburn:Durant on Brown's comments:

“We don't need to say shit like that. Let's just go out there and hoop.”

Kevin Durant on Bruce Brown, Apr 13, 2022. Source: Twitter @GwashburnGlobe.

item.title: Steve Nash on Bruce Brown
item.description:
Kristian Winfield:Steve Nash on why Bruce Brown has been outside the main rotation:

“We know what Bruce can do.. we don’t know how we can look with the bigger lineups.”

Steve Nash on Bruce Brown, Oct 22, 2021. Source: Twitter @Krisplashed.

item.title: Steve Nash on Bruce Brown
item.description:
Ohm Youngmisuk:Steve Nash on Bruce Brown:

“Bruce is gonna have to be patient... We know if we need competitiveness, combativeness and energy, we know we’ve got in Bruce. He’s definitely gonna play for us... Right now we’re looking at exploring some other things until we understand what we have.”

Steve Nash on Bruce Brown, Oct 21, 2021. Source: Twitter @NotoriousOHM.

item.title: Troy Weaver on Bruce Brown
item.description:

We feel like we have a good mixture of young guys with those two staples to start there.”

Troy Weaver on Bruce Brown, Jun 23, 2020. Source: Detroit News.

item.title: Dwane Casey on Langston Galloway, Bruce Brown
item.description:
Casey said of Robinson's spotty minutes.

“I tell guys all the time, if an opportunity comes, be ready to step in because you never know,whether it's Bruce Brown, Glenn Robinson, Langston (Galloway). Our guys have done a heck of a job being ready when their number is called.”

Dwane Casey on Langston Galloway, Bruce Brown, Nov 6, 2018. Source: Detroit Free Press.
